steps.caption: Your plan for today. It is built by itself at 08:00 your time (India time by default).
Want it earlier, or after a busy morning? Press Build now. It is rebuilt from the latest data.
The plan is built from your meetings, tasks, calendar records and the daily brief — nothing is invented.
Scroll through the sections: meetings to prepare, commitments due, deals needing attention, signals.
Capacity: minutes in meetings, free time and task work against your working hours.
Warnings flag clashes: overlapping meetings, more meetings than your limit, overdue commitments.
Travel time says 'unknown' — CRE OS has no routing service, so it never guesses.
Suggestions are only suggestions: you decide what to move. Nothing is rescheduled for you.
Built every Friday at 18:00: new opportunities, priority account changes, signals and meetings of the week.
Further down: overdue commitments, changed requirements and active deals — a checklist for next week.
